matching.rule: target file matches a variant when contentSha256 equals the variant sha256 (byte-exact) or when canonicalLfSha256 equals (CRLF/LF-only difference under autocrlf); no other normalization
matching.anchorRule: kind=generic or empty files are cleanup candidates only when strong bundle anchor holds: exact .lingma/index.json match (fb-rules install metadata) or >= 8 exact exclusive-file matches
